scope: single-site previously inspected development data; EC within-condition and EO condition-shift evaluation
evaluation_role: outer held-out development evaluation; previously inspected release, not untouched final external validation
selection_role: one nested subject-disjoint inner validation holdout per outer fold, equal-person MSE; choose ridge alpha per target and neural width/epoch by average standardized-target MSE; no refit on validation
calibration_role: per-output affine fitted on inner validation predictions only; report both uncalibrated and validation-calibrated R2
units: cached whole-run demeaned/95th-percentile-normalized ROI targets; R2 and amplitude are not absolute patient BOLD calibration
causality: new input construction uses past samples only; inherited artifact removal, target preprocessing and frame QC are retrospective
uncertainty: 2000 percentile bootstrap resamples of people, paired by person for differences; exploratory intervals, no multiplicity correction, one subset order and one neural seed
interpretation: bounded learning-resource and state-shift comparisons; no scaling law, equivalence, clinical utility, or end-to-end online claim
neural_objective: 193 standardized outputs jointly fitted; each of global, regional64, global-residual64, global+phys-residual64 groups has weight 1/4. Shared MLP representation differs from independent per-output ridge; not an isolated parameter-count intervention.
ridge_objective: independent-output raw-target MSE; per-output alpha on equal-person validation MSE. Standardizing any one output would not change its selected alpha.
